bullet: Unknown sign-ins on the redirect route (`F19.oauth-redirect-unknown-state`).
script:
JX=$(control-agent-server api POST /api/mcp/oauth/start --expect 200 --check ok eq true --field job_id \ --json "$(jq -nc --argjson s "$OAUTH_SRV" --arg cb "$RUN_URL" '{server: $s, timeout: 60, callback_base_url: $cb}')") control-agent-server api GET "/api/mcp/oauth/status/$JX" --check callback_ready eq true --until-ok 20 XQ=$("$PY" -c "$QS_OF" "$(curl -s --noproxy '*' -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' "$(control-agent-server api GET "/api/mcp/oauth/status/$JX" --field authorization_url)")") XCODE=$(echo "$XQ" | jq -r .code) XSTATE=$(echo "$XQ" | jq -r .state) test -n "$XCODE" && test -n "$XSTATE" && test "$XSTATE" != qa-f19-forged control-agent-server api GET /api/mcp/oauth/redirect --auth none --query "code=$XCODE" --query state=qa-f19-forged --expect 400 \ --check . contains '

Authorization failed

' --check . contains 'This sign-in is unknown or has expired.' --save F19.oauth-redirect-unknown-state/forged-state control-agent-server api GET /api/mcp/oauth/redirect --auth none --query "code=$XCODE" --query state= --expect 400 \ --check . contains 'This sign-in is unknown or has expired.' control-agent-server api GET /api/mcp/oauth/redirect --auth none --query "code=$XCODE" --expect 400 \ --check . contains 'This sign-in is unknown or has expired.' --save F19.oauth-redirect-unknown-state/no-state control-agent-server api GET "/api/mcp/oauth/status/$JX" --check status eq authorizing --check oauth_state missing --save F19.oauth-redirect-unknown-state/still-waiting control-agent-server api GET /api/mcp/oauth/redirect --auth none --query error=access_denied --query 'error_description=QA denied' --query "state=$XSTATE" \ --expect 400 --check . contains '

Authorization failed

' --check . contains 'The provider reported: QA denied' --save F19.oauth-redirect-unknown-state/denied control-agent-server api GET "/api/mcp/oauth/status/$JX" --until-ok 15 --save F19.oauth-redirect-unknown-state/failed \ --check status eq failed --check ok eq false --check error eq 'Client failed to connect: OAuth authorization failed: QA denied' \ --check error_kind eq connection --check oauth_state missing --check tools missing
